title: Nigeria: dangerous drugs registers
notice: A starting point, not certified for the country. Check each column against the instrument before you rely on it. The First Schedule's two parts, read off the form images, one register per class of reg. 18(1)(b). The law does not state the register's medium for a retail pharmacy: this set keeps signed printed pages. Form in which obtained or supplied prints the item's stock unit: name the unit by its form (tablet, ampoule, syrup). The ingredients of a prescription are a Desk field: a counter sale prints them empty, so write them in. Codeine, dionin, dihydrocodeine and morpholinylethylmorphine have no book here: the Modified Form Regulations (reg. 3) take them out of reg. 18 for a seller who is not a wholesale dealer (reg. 9), so never class them as other Part III drugs. Until the register door books a return by its direction, a customer's return prints in Part B and a return to the supplier in Part A, each as a movement of its own: mark it by hand.
sources: Dangerous Drugs Act, Cap. D1, Laws of the Federation of Nigeria: s. 8(1) (the drugs to which Part III applies)
Dangerous Drugs Regulations (under Cap. D1): reg. 18 (record to be kept), reg. 26 (records kept two years), First Schedule Parts A and B (lawsofnigeria.placng.org D1.pdf, pp. 35-37)
Dangerous Drugs (Modified Form) Regulations: regs. 3 and 9 (codeine and dionin); Dangerous Drugs (Application to Alphaprodine, Amidone, etc.) Order and the other Orders applying Part III

books.title: Part A cocaine and ecgonine
books.form: First Schedule, Part A: Record of raw opium, coca leaves and drugs to which Part III of the Dangerous Drugs Act applies, purchased or otherwise obtained
books.cite: Dangerous Drugs Regulations reg. 18(1)(a), First Schedule Part A; reg. 18(1)(b)(i) cocaine and ecgonine and substances containing them; corrections by a dated marginal note, reg. 18(1)(f); kept 2 years, reg. 26
books.medium_note: The Regulations do not state the medium of a retail register (reg. 18(1)(a): a register kept for the sole purpose): print each day's pages, sign them and keep them as the register. One register per premises (reg. 18(1)(d)): map all of a premises' stores to one register store.
